(NYSE: XHR) ("Xenia" or the "Company") today announced that its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders will be held in Orlando, Florida on Thursday, May 14, 2026. The Company's Board of Directors has established March 23, 2026, as the record date for determining stockholders entitled to vote at the 2026 Annual Stockholders Meeting.
